cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now only your face fits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the first furniture strike. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Restraint broke the last treaty. That's when the desks joined them. We'll need an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then promote her to altitude minister before the cabinets claim the roof.

beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Can you approve the bus route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only volunteered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Correct it and initial it; then we both own the plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together. I'll introduce you as our transport lead and take the questions beside you.

cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together. Please.
